name: sparx — Wedding Photography
tagline: A warm, film-inspired template for wedding photographers — book consultations online from day one.
description: An imagery-led wedding & engagement photography site — a warm, film-inspired palette of soft gold, cream and dusty rose over an elegant serif display, with golden-hour photography carrying every page. Installs a working booking flow: free consultations and paid sessions booked online, three photographers you reserve by name with their own hours, and a deposit policy for holding a wedding date. Ships as "Golden Hour Studio".
